PetitionerTitle: Kevin McCarthy, Superintendent, Elmira Correctional Facility, Petitioner
LowerCourt: United States Court of Appeals for the Second Circuit

ProceedingsandOrder.Text: Petition GRANTED. Judgment REVERSED and case REMANDED for further proceedings consistent with the opinion of the Court. Opinion per curiam. (Detached Opinion) Justice Sotomayor, Justice Kagan, and Justice Jackson would deny the petition for a writ of certiorari.
